meta_description:
61K likes, 293 comments - gauravmolri on September 12, 2026: "Let’s get the wedding glow up together. Save this shot recipe 🤌🏻

Brother getting married  this year so i am going all in. What about you? Are you having wedding in your family? 😉

Recipe of juice here⬇️

2 beetroot 2 carrots 1 apple, just blend them 

You can ginger and lemon when you drink it. Btw yes it can be stored for until 3 days in fridge 
Rest 4 days i actually deep freeze into cubes or maybe in air tight container

Then you can use it in different ways. Best i use the cubes when i drinking water and add them into it

Super easy and manageable 🤌🏻

#juice".
